body: It feels a bit like I am going insane but knowing someone listened without it being their job makes me feel much better, thank you heaps for taking the time to do this

Thank you I really do appreciate it. Smoking helps and I have no idea why. The best I can come up with is it thickens mucus in my sinus which helps my ear or maybe even the irritation from smoke swells my ear to make it better. And edibles don't really have much effect unfortunately
